description: Expected calibration cells for the Qwen3-8B (dense attention, hidden 4,096) execution class on H200 bf16 (2026-09-04): the exact cells of the shape-lattice launch below (dev/trainer_rank_cost_calibration_lattice.sky.yaml; TP1 x CP1/2/4, TP2 x CP1 and TP2 x CP2), keyed exactly as the fitter keys cells. TP1 x CP4 and TP2 x CP2 are measured but excluded from the table: the ten-term score cannot see the context-parallel exchange schedule there (design brief, known limitation).

excluded.reason: TP1 x CP4 is withheld from calibrated scoring for attention classes: the ten-term score cannot see the context-parallel exchange schedule (wave count, per-wave rank load) and misranks layouts on the recurring Ellavox groups; version 1 stays the fallback there until the CP-aware re-ranker is certified (dev/trainer_rank_planner_design.md, known limitation)
